intro: Here are the questions students ask most before they enroll — straight answers, no fluff.

items.question: I'm a complete beginner. Is this for me?
items.answer: Yes. This course is designed for absolute beginners. You don't need any design background. Everything is taught step by step — from fundamentals to building real projects and a portfolio.

items.question: What tools will I be learning?
items.answer: You'll learn industry-standard tools including Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, Notion, and modern AI tools that help designers research faster, create better designs, and improve productivity.

items.question: How is this different from free YouTube content?
items.answer: YouTube is unstructured. You'll keep jumping between videos without a clear path. This course gives you a complete roadmap, real assignments, and a system that takes you from zero to job-ready — without confusion.

items.question: What if I get stuck or need help?
items.answer: You'll have access to a private community where you can ask questions, get feedback, and stay accountable. You're not learning alone.

items.question: Do I need to know Figma first?
items.answer: No. Figma is taught from scratch inside the course. You'll learn everything you need as you progress.

items.question: How long do I have access?
items.answer: You'll get 1 year of access. You can learn at your own pace and revisit the content anytime.

items.question: How much time do I need to invest?
items.answer: If you're serious, 1–2 hours per day is enough to make consistent progress. The more you execute, the faster you'll see results.

items.question: Will I get a job after this course?
items.answer: If you follow the process, complete projects, and apply consistently — you'll be in a strong position to get shortlisted and crack interviews.

items.question: Is this worth ₹6999?
items.answer: If you're looking for random videos, no. If you want a clear path, real skills, and a portfolio that can get you interviews, this is built for that. One good opportunity can easily recover your investment.

items.question: What if I don't like the course?
items.answer: Go through the curriculum carefully before enrolling. Since this is a digital product with full access, refunds are not provided by default.

items.question: Can I learn this while working or studying?
items.answer: Yes. The course is self-paced. You can fit it into your schedule and progress consistently without needing full-time commitment.
